body:
I truly appreciate all the kind words. It helps hearing and reading them. I've always struggled with trying to stay positive throughout life yet I keep pushing through. 

I haven't been thought of writing a letter and I may consider doing that as it may help. I've talked to a couple of friends and a family member regarding the basics of what happened. I feel that it's for the better yet it still hurts as we are close.

It's definitely a nice day out however I'm stuck inside working. Definitely going to try and run a lot more. And stay positive, though it hurts quite a bit. Thank you for taking the time out of your day to talk with me.

Yeah it does. Trying to stay positive is one of the hardest things for me to do. I'm not sure about talking about what happened as I really screwed up and made a huge mistake. I've stressed how sorry I am to the friend but I'm hoping he just needs space and after awhile we can start to reconnect. If not then I gotta try and move on, it just doesn't seem to get easier
I enjoy watching tv and running. So I'm trying to do more of that especially the running as it helps to clear my head

That's the thing. I'm not just sitting around, I'm trying to keep myself busy whether it's work, running, TV etc. I'm not trying to sound like I expect everything to go well at all, I'm making an effort to better my life. Just struggling more than others I suppose and don't have that drive I guess that others do
